spc-parameter.title: SPC Parameter View
spc-parameter.description: The Navigator shell routes this parameter to the Process Control module, which renders the control chart, histogram and records here. Charts are owned by that module — not the Navigator.

spc-charts.title: SPC Charts
spc-charts.description: Control charts for the selected parameter would render in this hosted region.

records-table.title: Records
records-table.description: A paginated records table would load here. Supports large, scrollable, dynamically refreshed datasets.

placeholderFields.label: Columns
placeholderFields.value: Status, Timestamp, Sample, X-Bar, Sigma, User

violations.title: Violations
violations.description: Open and historical violations for the selected object would render here.

reporting-dashboard.title: Reporting Dashboard
reporting-dashboard.description: A reporting dashboard would be hosted here. The Navigator only routes to it; the Reporting module owns the visuals.

process-control.title: Process Control
process-control.description: Process control screens for the selected scope would load in this region.

equipment-overview.title: Equipment Overview
equipment-overview.description: An equipment overview screen would load here with its parameters and status.

object-summary.title: Object Summary
object-summary.description: A summary view for the selected container object would load here.
